deviations.reason: The first deploy-headless.sh run landed but verify-deploy's fast gates failed on a shellcheck SC1090 finding in Phase 3's new tj_scope_expected() helper (test-validate-artifact.sh:806) -- a dynamic source missing the '# shellcheck disable=SC1090' directive every other dynamic-source site in this codebase carries. This was a genuine defect introduced in Phase 3, only surfaced by Phase 5's full gate run (Phase 3's own scoped verify-touched.sh invocation did not happen to select the shellcheck lint). Fixed forward in Phase 5 by adding the directive, re-confirmed 0 shellcheck findings and 157/157 test-validate-artifact.sh assertions unchanged, then re-ran deploy-headless.sh to a clean landing.

notes: Two foreign, NEW (not expected) failures were observed across two verify-touched.sh invocations during this phase: test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh and test-stall-reprompt-wiring.sh. Neither is named in any of this task's 5 phases' own Tier Justifications, and neither file this task touched. Both are attributable to the shared multi-agent working tree's OWED fallback set sweeping in other concurrently-live dispatches' uncommitted files (e.g. agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/continuation-pointer-lib.sh, modified before this dispatch began, per the session's initial git-status snapshot). Recorded per the Observation Duty via issue-record.sh as concurrent-write-observed/minor, non-blocking, and explicitly not attributed to this task's own work.

The complete gate set is deferred to the once-per-invocation orchestration close per this dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive; this phase's own scoped obligation (verify-touched.sh over this task's 4 touched files, plus deploy-headless.sh's own fast-gate verify-deploy pass) is what was actually run and is green modulo the two foreign observations above.
